Support cue: none
Small-size requirement: one stable mass at 64, 32, 24, and 16 pixels, with broad folds and open negative space

inspect semantic recognition and the monochrome silhouette at 16, 24, 32, and 64 px
inspect the icon on light and dark surrounding backgrounds
